quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: What should you do when approaching an accident scene?

options.text: Focus on your own driving.
Keep moving.
Stop if you are involved or if emergency help has not arrived yet.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Only stop at an accident scene if you are involved or emergency help has not arrived. Focus on your driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Do not drive to accidents, fires, or disasters just to look.

questions.question: Which light tells you to slow down and be careful at an intersection?

options.text: A flashing yellow light
A flashing red light
A solid yellow light
A solid red light

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. Be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: A large truck ahead is turning right onto a street with two lanes in each direction. The truck:

options.text: May complete its turn in either of the two lanes.
May need to swing wide to complete the right turn.
Must stay in the right lane at all times while turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: May need to swing wide to complete the right turn.
questions.explanation: The rear wheels of a vehicle follow a shorter path than the front wheels. Long trucks need extra space to turn, so they often swing wide when turning right.

questions.question: Can you drive around the gates at a railroad crossing?

options.text: Yes, when the train has passed.
No, never.
Yes, when the lights stop flashing.
Yes, when other drivers do it.

questions.explanation: You must stop at all railroad crossings when signals warn of a train. Signals include flashing red lights, a lowered crossing gate, a flagger, or a train whistle. Never drive around a lowered gate.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: A school or school crosswalk is ahead.
Slow down, drive with care, and watch for children.
Both of the above.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers near schools to slow down, drive carefully, and look for children.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or crying, they should:

options.text: Drive normally because emotions do not affect driving.
Drive faster because they are more alert.
Calm down and focus before starting to drive.
Call a friend to talk while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Calm down and focus before starting to drive.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions make it hard to drive safely. Your mind is focused on what is bothering you, not the road. Take time to calm down and focus before you start driving.

questions.question: If your turn signals do not work, what should you use to show you are turning?

options.text: Your horn
Your headlights
Hand signals
Your emergency flashers

questions.explanation: If your turn signals do not work, use hand signals to tell other drivers when you are turning.

questions.question: Motorcycles, scooters, and mopeds are hard to see. You should:

options.text: Slow down when driving.
Keep looking around constantly.
Share a lane with a motorcycle.

questions.explanation: Motorcycles are small and can hide in blind spots or be missed easily. Always watch for motorcycles, mopeds, and scooters.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaching, you must:

options.text: Keep your speed and lane until it passes.
Move to the right lane and drive slowly until it passes.
Pull to the edge of the road and stop until it passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the edge of the road and stop until it passes.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle approaches with flashing lights, pull to the right edge of the road and stop. On one-way streets, pull to the nearest edge.

questions.question: What does alcohol do to a driver?

options.text: Reduces focus.
Causes poor coordination.
Slows down decision-making.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol harms your vision, judgment, focus, and coordination.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right.
You cannot turn right.
You can turn right on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means no right turns are allowed. It is illegal to turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Move carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. Let all vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection pass. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: After passing a vehicle, it is safe to return to your lane when:

options.text: The driver you passed signals you to move back.
You signal for three seconds.
You can see the headlights of the car you passed in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can see the headlights of the car you passed in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Before moving back to your lane, make sure you have enough space between you and the car you passed. If you can see both of its headlights in your rearview mirror, you have enough room to return safely to your lane.

questions.question: "No zones" are areas around trucks where cars:

options.text: Cannot be seen by the truck driver or are so close that the driver cannot stop or steer safely.
Have plenty of space to travel behind the truck.
Are several car lengths away from the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cannot be seen by the truck driver or are so close that the driver cannot stop or steer safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are blind spots around trucks where cars disappear from view. They also include areas where cars are so close to a truck that the truck driver cannot stop or turn safely. A car in a "no zone" greatly increases the risk of a crash.

questions.question: Traffic control devices in construction and maintenance work areas are the color:

options.text: Red.
Orange.
Yellow.

questions.explanation: Orange signs are used in work zones. Be extra careful when you see orange signs, cones, or barriers on the road.

questions.question: When a car with bright headlights drives toward you at night, you should:

options.text: Stop until the other car passes.
Look below their headlights.
Look toward the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right edge of your lane.
questions.explanation: Do not look directly at bright headlights coming toward you at night. Instead, look at the right edge of the road until the other car passes.

questions.question: If bad weather makes it hard to see, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get off the road quickly.
Drive in the lane closest to oncoming traffic.
Stay farther behind other cars.

questions.explanation: When you cannot see clearly due to darkness or bad weather, increase the distance between you and the car ahead. This gives you more time to react if something unexpected happens.

questions.question: On a two-lane street, a fire engine is following you but is not using emergency signals. You should:

options.text: Drive normally.
Stop as quickly as possible.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without using its siren or lights, you do not need to pull over. Just keep driving normally.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing, you must:

options.text: Watch for vehicles that must stop at railroad crossings, such as school buses and trucks carrying hazardous materials.
Watch for trains coming from either direction.
Both of the above.

questions.explanation: Always be very careful at railroad crossings. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming from any direction. Also watch for vehicles that are required to stop at all crossings, like school buses and trucks carrying hazardous materials.

questions.question: A green arrow with a red light means:

options.text: You can only drive straight.
You can only drive in the direction the arrow points.
You must wait for a green light to drive in any direction.
All vehicles must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can only drive in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: A green arrow with a red light means you can only drive in the direction the arrow shows, and only if the intersection is clear.

questions.question: You should signal while turning because it:

options.text: Is illegal to turn off your signal before completing a turn.
Tells other drivers what you plan to do.
Is always unsafe to turn off a signal before completing a turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tells other drivers what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: Signal when turning, changing lanes, slowing down, or stopping. This tells other drivers, motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians what you are going to do.

questions.question: When can you go through an intersection with a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check for cross traffic.
After coming to a complete stop and making sure it is safe.
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection.
After slowing down to 10 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and making sure it is safe.
questions.explanation: Stop before the stop line or crosswalk at any stop sign. If there is a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk, stop before entering the intersection. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: When a school bus is picking up or dropping off children, you must:

options.text: Stop, no matter which direction you are going.
Stop if you are driving in the same direction.
Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, no matter which direction you are going.
questions.explanation: When you see a school bus picking up or dropping off children, you must come to a complete stop before reaching the bus. This applies no matter which direction you are traveling.

questions.question: When backing up:

options.text: Look out the rear window.
Press hard on the gas pedal.
Only use your rearview mirror.

questions.explanation: When backing up, put your right arm on the back of the passenger seat and look directly out the rear window. Do not rely only on your mirrors because they cannot show what is directly behind your vehicle. Back up slowly.

questions.question: When driving in bad weather, drivers should:

options.text: Speed up to reach their destination faster.
Stay closer to the car ahead.
Stay farther from the car ahead.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther from the car ahead.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead of you.

questions.question: To see better when it is raining or foggy, drivers should use their:

options.text: Low beam headlights.
High beam headlights.
Parking lights.

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in rain or fog. They help other drivers see you, even if they do not help you see much better.

questions.question: When driving on an interstate:

options.text: Stop on the shoulder if you are tired.
Always use cruise control.
Signal, check mirrors, and check blind spots before changing lanes.
Change lanes often.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, check mirrors, and check blind spots before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Signal, check your mirrors, and check your blind spot before changing lanes on an interstate. Only stop on the shoulder in an emergency. Change lanes as few times as possible. Do not use cruise control in heavy traffic or bad weather.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Sharp turn ahead, slow down.
Work crew ahead.
Side road.
Playground ahead.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that there is a sharp turn coming and you should slow down.

questions.question: You may text while driving:

options.text: If you can text without looking at your phone.
Never.
If you use voice-to-text.
If you only look away for a moment.

questions.explanation: Texting while driving is illegal. Using a cell phone while driving is a major distraction and is not safe.

questions.question: Is it legal to cross a double solid yellow line to pass?

options.text: Yes.
No.
If there is no oncoming traffic.
If the car ahead is driving below the speed limit.

questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing. You cannot cross these lines to pass another car. You can only cross double yellow lines when turning into a driveway or entrance.
